frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 9-slice PNG frame for a Chinese xianxia idle game's dialog, not a screenshot or mockup. Primary request: redesign an ugly overly ornate UI into restrained premium game art. One square 1024x1024 orthographic frame, front-facing, precisely aligned to image edges with at most 8px transparent exterior margin. A slim ink-teal lacquer rim with one hairline of aged pale gold, tiny jade inlays only at the four chamfered corners, subtly hand-painted mineral texture. Center is a very large completely TRANSPARENT empty opening, including all space where DOM text will go. The full visual border occupies only the outer 64px of the square; corners contained in those 64px. Straight, uniform opposite edges designed to stretch as a CSS nine-slice without seams. Visual direction: serene cultivation, mist mountains, elegant dark blue-green UI, natural material subtle highlights. Matte, not glossy, no ornate vines, dragons, clouds, scallops, filigree, jewels, bevel stacks, glowing halo, symbols, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No object or scenery in the opening. Real alpha transparency in the center and outside; not a checkerboard painted as pixels.
